summary: Full-stack test of Diretor Security Audit (backend audit endpoints + SecurityAudit UI card on /admin/diretor). Backend: all 4 pytest cases pass (GET latest, POST propor, invalid finding 404, partner 403). Frontend: SecurityAudit card renders with counts (45 alta, 31 media, 8 baixa), filter chip audit-filter-alta narrows list from 84 to 45, first finding details show descricao/correcao/diff, clicking audit-propose-* shows toast 'Correção colocada em Ações Pendentes', button becomes disabled 'Correção já proposta', and acoes-pendentes-count increases. No console errors observed (only a benign WebSocket warning during page load).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_diretor.py:340 stores acao_id back into the finding on propose, which correctly powers the 'Correção já proposta' state — good. Consider clearing acao_id if the action is rejected so admin can re-propose.
The auditoria run uses LLM (~60s). No rate limiting on POST /api/diretor/auditoria — admin-only mitigates but consider a cooldown to avoid accidental double runs.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 pending propor_correcao actions from existing audit findings (fd-b2c2d68a1e, fd-e6dd3ea79f) during test flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Existing audit doc has 84 findings (45/31/8). Do NOT trigger POST /api/diretor/auditoria unless GET returns empty; it takes ~60s and uses LLM credits.
